scripts.mg: sequelize-cli migration:generate --config src/config/config.js --migrations-path src/db/migrations --name "" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const f=fs.readdirSync('src/db/migrations').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js')).sort((a,b)=>fs.statSync(p.join('src/db/migrations',b)).mtime-fs.statSync(p.join('src/db/migrations',a)).mtime)[0];fs.renameSync(p.join('src/db/migrations',f),p.join('src/db/migrations',f.replace('.js','.cjs')));"
